subject.title: feat(nodes): make computer.act eligibility capability-based for desktop nodes

question: Should advertised `computer.act` plus `screen.snapshot` be accepted as sufficient authorization to expose model-directed desktop input on Windows/Linux before an audited bundled fulfiller exists?
rationale: The patch intentionally replaces a platform allow boundary with a self-advertised capability boundary for dangerous desktop input; code review cannot determine whether that is the intended long-term node trust model.

options.title: Keep the platform gate until a fulfiller lands
options.body: Leave non-macOS nodes ineligible and introduce their capability path together with the supervised executor and end-to-end safety proof.

options.title: Accept the capability contract now
options.body: Merge the policy change after adding real-node evidence that the non-macOS command and frame-binding contracts are enforced equivalently.

recommendation.title: Keep the platform gate until a fulfiller lands
recommendation.body: Leave non-macOS nodes ineligible and introduce their capability path together with the supervised executor and end-to-end safety proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the proposed capability and node-policy transition in the reviewed branch.
